source: real texture pixels: terrain_texture_display.jpg (8192x8192, 0.285 ground m/texel = 0.2986 EPSG:3857 units)
method: rectified facade strips (roof edge -> base along measured lean); floor pitch from row-profile periodicity, window pitch from column-profile periodicity; confidence vs an in-image null bank of ground/roof strips
lean_note: MEASURED here from the texture. It disagrees with scene.json lean_m_per_m (which the viewer uses to find facade texels) in both direction and size; floor_pitch_m scales as 1/lean magnitude, whose uncertainty is ~+-15 %
world_frame: x = easting - affine[2], z = northing - affine[5] (source CRS units / crs_units_per_m, which is 1 here); x east, z north -- same as viewer realCoordsAt and build_city_image context placement
footprint_caveat: buildings.geojson polygons are often fragments of a building and do not always sit on the roof outline in the texture; walls whose strip lands on roof/ground simply fail the null test

mask_encoding.grid: 8192x8192, same bounds as texture_file (texture UV space)
mask_encoding.R: window-cell (glass) likelihood from the lattice fitted to that wall's own pixels (0/255); INFERRED which phase is glass (majority phase)
mask_encoding.G: 255 = lattice detected (conf>=0.9 on floor or window axis); 96 = facade strip analysed, no lattice; 0 = not a facade strip

summary.null_false_alarm_note: confidence c means the statistic beats a fraction c of same-size ground/roof strips from this image; Bonferroni-corrected over a building's walls. Expect ~10% of pure-noise buildings above 0.9 before correction.
